description: This file defines structures and functions for reading and parsing network protocol statistics from /proc/net/protocols in Linux, including details about protocol capabilities.

methods.name: NetProtocols
methods.description: Reads and parses network protocol statistics from /proc/net/protocols.

methods.name: parseNetProtocols
methods.description: Parses scanner data into NetProtocolStats map.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of protocol data into NetProtocolStatLine.

methods.name: parseCapabilities
methods.description: Parses capability strings into NetProtocolCapabilities fields.
